mechanism: Tranylcypromine inhibits CYP3A4, significantly reducing simvastatin metabolism and increasing statin levels with risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis; potential additive effects on serotonergic pathways and hypertensive crisis risk.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use alternative statin (pravastatin or rosuvastatin, CYP3A4-independent) or consider alternative antidepressant; monitor for muscle pain, weakness, and elevated CK if continued.
